task: event-time behavior inputs to retrospective session-energy proxy target
split_policy: retain old train/test clock boundaries; split old validation into chronological equal tuning/calibration halves; contain full X/Y within each segment; purge immature labels
availability: event time strictly before origin bin end; zero ingestion delay ASSUMED, not measured
target: equal-bin session energy, kWh per 15min, retrospective proxy only
target_label_policy: access OR departure OR proxy jump; jump positive-difference 90th percentile fitted on mature training prefix only

rule.multi_horizon: origin trigger repeated for all four horizons

graph.pattern_phase: 96-step UTC phase anchored at first grid timestamp; not civil-day average

training_plan.selection: tuning MAE in original proxy units
training_plan.calibration: never used for early stopping or tuning

scope: data/input protocol freeze only; no model training or performance claim
test_status: previously inspected, retrospective verification, NOT untouched confirmation
